heading: Server Motherboard
bottomHtml:
Server Motherboard in Bangladesh | Enterprise Server Motherboard – OTECH BD


A Server Motherboard is the core component of enterprise and data-center servers, engineered for maximum reliability, performance, and continuous 24/7 operation. At OTECH BD, we offer a premium collection of server motherboards in Bangladesh designed for business servers, cloud infrastructure, virtualization platforms, storage servers, and high-performance computing systems.


Our server motherboards support Intel Xeon and AMD EPYC processors, ensuring powerful multi-core processing and enterprise-grade stability. Built with ECC memory support, advanced power delivery, and extensive expansion capabilities, these motherboards are ideal for mission-critical workloads where data integrity and uptime matter most.


OTECH BD server motherboards feature multiple PCIe expansion slots, high-speed SATA, SAS, and NVMe storage interfaces, and integrated IPMI/BMC remote management, allowing administrators to monitor and control servers remotely. With built-in high-speed networking options, these boards deliver reliable connectivity for modern enterprise environments.


Whether you are building a rack server, tower server, virtualization server, or storage NAS system, OTECH BD provides reliable, compatible, and enterprise-ready server motherboards from trusted global brands at competitive prices in Bangladesh.
